product.title: Spectacular Sunset Sail on San Diego Bay

description.text: Sail San Diego Bay at sunset with a captain who shares local stories and wildlife insight along the way. This approximately two-hour experience offers skyline views from the water, a relaxed pace, and the option to book a private sailing if preferred.

highlights: Enjoy sunset views of San Diego Bay from the water rather than from shore.
Sail with a captain who shares area stories and wildlife commentary during the cruise.
Watch for dolphins, sea lions, and seasonal whale sightings while underway.
Choose between a shared sail or upgrade to a private option.

start.description: Safe Harbor Marina, 955 Harbor Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92101. Meet at Gate 1 Docks A through D and arrive about 20 minutes before departure.

itineraryItems.title: San Diego
itineraryItems.description: Pass-by views of downtown San Diego and the city waterfront during the evening sail.

itineraryItems.title: San Diego Bay
itineraryItems.description: Cruise through the bay for skyline and sunset views from open water.

itineraryItems.title: Maritime Museum of San Diego
itineraryItems.description: Pass by the museum area while sailing the central bay route.

itineraryItems.title: Coronado Bridge
itineraryItems.description: See Coronado Bridge from the water as conditions permit.

itineraryItems.title: Cabrillo National Monument
itineraryItems.description: View the Point Loma shoreline area associated with Cabrillo National Monument from the bay.

inclusions: Sunset sail on San Diego Bay
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking.
Not recommended for travelers with back problems.
Bring layers, sensible shoes, and a waterproof shell; sunglasses and sunscreen are recommended.
You may bring easy-to-handle snacks and drinks.

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point?
faqs.answer: Meet at Safe Harbor Marina, 955 Harbor Island Dr, San Diego, at Gate 1 Docks A through D. Arrive about 20 minutes before departure.
